kurz: Honey and syrup are liquid sugar with a little acid. They brown faster and keep baked goods moister than granulated sugar.
bild_im_kopf: Like sugar in a coat of moisture.
was_passiert: Honey contains a lot of fructose and a little acid. Fructose browns at a lower temperature and attracts moisture.
faustregeln: Bake things made with honey a little cooler; they brown faster.
Gingerbread stays soft for a long time thanks to honey.
